24:45.sourceText: Τίς ἄρα ἐστὶν ὁ πιστὸς δοῦλος καὶ φρόνιμος ὃν κατέστησεν ὁ κύριος ἐπὶ τῆς οἰκετείας αὐτοῦ τοῦ δοῦναι αὐτοῖς τὴν τροφὴν ἐν καιρῷ;
24:45.targetText: Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom the master has put in charge of his household, to give the others their food at the proper time?

groups.note: αὐτοῖς, "to them", refers to the household, rendered the others.
The article τήν is rendered as the possessive their.

24:46.targetText: Blessed is that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.

groups.note: ὃν … ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ, "whom … his master", is rendered whose master … him.
